title.zh: 将哥打巴托省桑托斯将军市镇布阿扬小学的名称变更为拉高小学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Buayan Elementary School in the Municipality of General P. Santos, Province of Cotabato, to Lagao Elementary School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Buayan Elementary School in the Municipality of General P. Santos, Province of Cotabato, to Lagao Elementary School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường tiểu học Buayan tại Thị trấn General P. Santos, Tỉnh Cotabato thành Trường tiểu học Lagao
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Buayan ในเทศบาล General P. Santos, จังหวัด Cotabato เป็นโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Lagao
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Sekolah Dasar Buayan di Kotamadya General P. Santos, Provinsi Cotabato menjadi Sekolah Dasar Lagao
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Sekolah Rendah Buayan di Perbandaran General P. Santos, Wilayah Cotabato menjadi Sekolah Rendah Lagao

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1959/ra_2535_1959.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of Buayan Elementary School in the Municipality of General P. Santos, Province of Cotabato, is changed to Lagao Elementary School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 21, 1959.
